manual_gui.result: Playback menu showed File Loop Ctrl+Shift+L and chapter Ctrl+Shift+>/< shortcuts. F entered fullscreen with visible blue video, yellow square, controller and both subtitle lanes; Ctrl+Alt+F restored the framed window.

Mute Ctrl+/, delay Shift+( and Shift+), reset Shift+_ displayed. Delay +0.5 command changed the reopened disabled information row to 0.5s; reset produced No Delay feedback. Volume information reflected 98.

Default menu showed +/-0.5 delay rows and their Shift+X/Z shortcuts without the small-step alternates. Secondary visibility Alt+V and online search Ctrl+Shift+D displayed. Scale Up produced 1.1; subsequent Scale Down produced 0.99, confirmed by signed sidebar slider -0.010101001. Delay +0.5 changed the settings field and reopened disabled information row to 0.5s.
After focusing the controls popup and using its screenshot coordinate space, scrolling exposed position, scale, font, size, colors, border and shadow.

automation_limitation: An initial wheel injection to the framed-host screenshot changed volume from 100 to 98 rather than scrolling the owned controls popup.
